hook: Juliana enters the cathedral in a white bridal gown full of anticipation, only to be abruptly stopped and told Gerald is marrying someone else.
cliffhanger: Juliana is left gasping and devastated, realizing her fiancé is holding her sister's hand at the altar.
standalone_clarity: A new viewer can easily understand the core conflict: a bride arriving at her wedding only to be betrayed.
narrative_context: The inciting incident of the series where Juliana's wedding is hijacked by her sister.
promotional_strength: High emotional stakes and a shocking betrayal immediately grab the viewer's attention.

evidence.observation: Juliana enters the church in a bridal gown.
The Lady in Gold Gown reveals she is marrying Gerald.

logline: Lady Juliana arrives at the cathedral in her late mother's bridal gown, only to suffer the ultimate betrayal when her fiancé Gerald abandons her at the altar for her cruel sister Clarissa with her family's full blessing.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Symmetrical framing on the heavy church doors as they slowly part, pushing in slightly as Juliana stands framed in the light, dressed in an elegant white silk gown.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Juliana pauses at the threshold, her expression bright with joyful anticipation, wearing her mother's vintage gown and an oval pendant necklace.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: High wide tracking shot following behind Juliana as she steps into the grand cathedral nave, facing the distant altar flanked by seated guests.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Juliana's face as her warm smile begins to falter into confusion.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Juliana's eyes widen slightly in bewilderment as she notices something amiss at the altar.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium profile shot at the altar showing Gerald in his dark tailcoat holding the gloved hand of the Lady in Gold Gown, with Juliana visible walking down the distant aisle.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot as Juliana stops midway down the aisle, confronted by a haughty matriarch in black velvet stepping into the foreground.

source_segments.label: MATRIARCH (Cold, Commanding)
source_segments.speaker: MATRIARCH
source_segments.text: You should turn around, Juliana.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Confused, Breathless)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: Why?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Over-the-shoulder medium close-up past the Matriarch to Juliana, looking past her toward the altar.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Desperate, Unbelieving)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: Gerald is waiting for me.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on the Matriarch wearing an ornate tiara and sapphire jewelry, gazing down with merciless disdain.

source_segments.label: MATRIARCH (Blunt, Unforgiving)
source_segments.speaker: MATRIARCH
source_segments.text: Not anymore.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Juliana's stricken face as the weight of the words sinks in.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Trembling, Pleading)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: What do you mean?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of the Matriarch gesturing dismissively toward the altar.

source_segments.label: MATRIARCH (Dismissive)
source_segments.speaker: MATRIARCH
source_segments.text: Look for yourself.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Juliana walks forward past the Matriarch, her breath hitching as she approaches the altar steps, looking up in shock.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium front tracking shot moving backward ahead of Juliana as she advances down the center aisle.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Panning shot across the seated wedding guests whispering and casting judging glances from the wooden pews.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Low-angle shot from behind Juliana looking up at Gerald and the Lady in Gold Gown standing proudly before the altar.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Juliana's trembling lips and shocked, tearful blue eyes.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Shaken, Whispering)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: Gerald?

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Heartbroken)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: Why are you holding her hand?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up insert of Gerald's fingers firmly interlocked with the white-gloved hand of the Lady in Gold Gown.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on the Lady in Gold Gown beaming with cruel triumph.

source_segments.label: LADY IN GOLD GOWN (Gloating, Smug)
source_segments.speaker: LADY IN GOLD GOWN
source_segments.text: Because he is marrying me.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Juliana as tears spill over her eyelashes.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Gasping, Devastated)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: No...

hook: Juliana's tearful expression transforms into a steely, defiant smile as she rejects her demanded silence and challenges her groom.
cliffhanger: Juliana delivers her final proud proclamation that she refuses to be the one who should be ashamed, leaving Gerald stunned and speechless.
standalone_clarity: A new viewer can easily understand a wronged bride turning the tables on her unfaithful groom with fierce dignity.
narrative_context: The climax of the episode where Juliana takes back her power after being humiliated at the altar.
promotional_strength: It offers a highly satisfying character turnaround, showing resilience and a powerful verbal takedown of the antagonist.

evidence.observation: A steely, defiant smile emerges through Juliana's pain.
Juliana tells Gerald he has shown everyone exactly what his word is worth.
Juliana proclaims she will not leave believing she was the one who should be ashamed.

logline: Publicly cast aside at the altar by Gerald for her sister Clarissa and abandoned by her own family, Juliana stands tall and turns her public humiliation into an unyielding indictment of Gerald's honor.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Profile close-up of Juliana turning her face back toward the altar, tears still shimmering on her cheeks.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Direct close-up on Juliana's face as a steely, defiant smile emerges through her pain.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Bitter, Defiant)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: Dignity?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Full shot of Juliana standing tall, her posture completely transforming into regal composure before the seated guests.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Clear, Accusing)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: You abandoned a woman who trusted you...

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium profile close-up on Gerald's hardening jawline, Clarissa blurred in the background.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Off-screen) (Sharp, Piercing)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: ...because another woman promised you greater beauty and wealth.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Closer angle on Gerald's uneasy expression as Juliana's voice commands the room.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium wide shot framing Juliana confronting Gerald from the foot of the altar stairs.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Steely, Resolute)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: Do not mistake my heartbreak for your victory, Gerald.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up push-in on Juliana, her blue eyes shining with fierce conviction.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Powerful, Unyielding)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: You wanted this entire chapel to believe that I was not worthy of you. But you have shown them something far more valuable.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium profile on Juliana looking up at Gerald, holding the entire hall spellbound.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Juliana's face, calm, dignified, and unwavering.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Decisive, Scathing)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: You have shown them exactly what your word is worth.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot on Gerald standing frozen on the altar steps, stunned and speechless under her public rebuke.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Low-angle wide shot of the grand cathedral nave, framing Juliana in pristine white at the center of the vaulted aisle.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Juliana lifts her chin high, commanding the space with unassailable dignity.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Resolute, Proud)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: I may leave this chapel without a husband...

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Dramatic medium close-up holding steadily on Juliana's radiant, proud face as she delivers her final proclamation.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Defiant, Triumphant in Spirit)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: ...but I will not leave it believing I was the one who should be ashamed.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Juliana breathes with steady resolve, holding her head high as the solemn orchestral score swells into the final beat.

hook: Juliana challenges the kneeling stranger by declaring she will not accept pity or charity, prompting his absolute vow.
cliffhanger: Juliana looks back at her cold family before making her final decision and telling the stranger she accepts.
standalone_clarity: A viewer can understand that a rejected woman is being offered a choice by a mysterious man against the backdrop of her cruel family, though his exact identity is unknown.
narrative_context: Juliana weighs the stranger's marriage proposal against her deep distrust and wounded pride before choosing to accept.
promotional_strength: Highlights the dramatic turning point where the protagonist decides to take a chance on an unknown protector rather than submit to further degradation.

evidence.observation: Juliana asserts her dignity, refusing pity.
The stranger replies that his offer is a vow.
Juliana resolves to accept the proposal.

logline: Defying Gerald and Clarissa's cruel mockery, Juliana accepts the mysterious scarred warrior's solemn proposal and is officially wed, choosing exile and dignity over her family's cruelty as they walk out into the light together.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana, her pride flaring through her sadness.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Defiant, Dignified)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: If this is pity, take back your ring.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Tight close-up on Juliana's face, a tear clinging to her cheek.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Fierce)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: I will not become anyone's charity.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man holding her gaze directly.

source_segments.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Earnest)
source_segments.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
source_segments.text: It is not pity, Lady Juliana.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Intense tight close-up on his piercing blue-green eyes and facial scars.

source_segments.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Deep, Absolute)
source_segments.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
source_segments.text: It is a vow.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Juliana, completely disarmed by the gravity of his promise.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (V.O.)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: I don't know this man.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of Lady Ashcroft, Clarissa, and Lord Ashcroft seated coldly in the family pew.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (V.O.)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: I don't know what waits beyond these doors.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Side profile close-up of Juliana looking toward her estranged family, then turning back.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (V.O.)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: But he looked at me when everyone else turned away.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana facing down at him, a faint, tender smile breaking across her lips.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Resolved)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: Then I accept.

hook: Gerald bursts into furious shouts as the marriage is finalized, reacting with rage to Juliana's choices.
cliffhanger: Juliana and her new husband walk hand-in-hand through the towering chapel doors into the bright daylight, turning their backs on her family.
standalone_clarity: A new viewer clearly sees a defiant bride cutting ties with her abusive family and former groom to walk out with a new partner.
narrative_context: The wedding concludes with Gerald and Lady Ashcroft hurling insults and disownment, which Juliana answers with calm finality before leaving.
promotional_strength: Delivers a satisfying emotional payoff where the protagonist stands tall against her tormentors and walks into a new beginning.

evidence.observation: Juliana delivers a cutting retort to Gerald.
Lady Ashcroft formally disowns Juliana.
The couple walks out into the sunlight together.

logline: Defying Gerald and Clarissa's cruel mockery, Juliana accepts the mysterious scarred warrior's solemn proposal and is officially wed, choosing exile and dignity over her family's cruelty as they walk out into the light together.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of Gerald lunging forward, pointing an enraged finger.

source_segments.label: GERALD (Furious, Shouting)
source_segments.speaker: GERALD
source_segments.text: You have thrown yourself away!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Tight close-up of Gerald, face contorted in rage.

source_segments.label: GERALD (Livid)
source_segments.speaker: GERALD
source_segments.text: For a penniless nobody!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium two-shot of Juliana standing tall before Gerald in the chapel aisle, her husband standing guard behind her.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Calm, Cutting)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: I would rather choose my own life...

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Juliana, her jaw set with unshakable pride.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Firm, Final)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: ...than spend another moment begging for yours.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Tight close-up of Gerald, eyes wide with speechless shock and wounded pride.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Gerald recoils slightly, mouth agape.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide shot of Lady Ashcroft rising abruptly from the front pew, pointing an accusatory hand toward the doors.

source_segments.label: LADY ASHCROFT (Imperious, Shouting)
source_segments.speaker: LADY ASHCROFT
source_segments.text: Do not bring this man anywhere near Ashcroft Manor!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Tight close-up of Lady Ashcroft, eyes blazing with cold malice.

source_segments.label: LADY ASHCROFT (Venomous)
source_segments.speaker: LADY ASHCROFT
source_segments.text: You are disowned!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of Lord Ashcroft bowing his head deeply over his cane in shame.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Juliana. Tears brim in her eyes at the formal rejection, but she does not break.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium two-shot as the Mysterious Bearded Man turns gently to Juliana, reaching his hand out once more.

source_segments.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Soft, Protective)
source_segments.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
source_segments.text: Come, Lady Juliana.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Juliana placing her hand securely into his, gripping his scarred hand.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide tracking shot behind Juliana and the warrior as they begin walking down the central aisle toward the chapel doors.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium three-shot of Gerald, Clarissa, and Lady Ashcroft watching in stunned silence and disbelief.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Clarissa gapes in shock while Lady Ashcroft exhales in exasperation.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide shot from the back of the chapel as the massive oak doors swing wide open, revealing bright daylight and the courtyard outside.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Juliana and the Mysterious Bearded Man walk hand-in-hand through the towering doors into the sunlight together, turning their backs on the ruined wedding as the screen fades out.

source_segments.label: SOUND FX
source_segments.text: Heavy oak doors creaking open, followed by a triumphant musical swell fading out into silence.

The man acknowledges that this is not the life Juliana came from.
Juliana reacts with hesitant surprise upon seeing the rustic cottage.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium full tracking shot of Juliana and the Mysterious Bearded Man trudging along a muddy, rain-soaked path in the dark woods.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Juliana lifts the hem of her white satin wedding gown to keep it out of the pooling mud, shivering under her dark hooded cloak.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Juliana's wet hand clutching her muddy dress.

source_segments.label: SOUND FX
source_segments.text: Heavy rain pouring through dense tree canopies with steady footfalls on wet earth.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Upward shot through the dripping, silhouetted branches into the stormy night sky.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium two-shot framing Juliana and the Mysterious Bearded Man as they pause in the misty woods.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Juliana turns back toward him, water glistening on her face and hair.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on the Mysterious Bearded Man, his dark hair soaked and rain running down the scars on his cheek.

source_segments.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Solemn, Gentle)
source_segments.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
source_segments.text: I know this is not the life you came from.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Juliana looking up into the rain, exhaling a soft breath of resignation.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Quiet, Melancholic)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: No.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Juliana looks upward into the canopy, gathering herself with a faint nod.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Resigned, Soft)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: It isn't.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man, gazing down at her with quiet remorse.

source_segments.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Guilt-ridden)
source_segments.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
source_segments.text: You should not have had to walk through this rain tonight.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Juliana's bodice and mother's pendant as she gathers her cloak closer.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Juliana's face, offering a wistful, comforting smile.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Faintly Ironic, Resilient)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: I suppose the day was already ruined.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Extreme close-up on the Mysterious Bearded Man's piercing eyes, touched by her lack of bitterness.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide establishing shot through tree branches showing a secluded, rustic stone cottage nestled among the misty trees.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: They walk forward toward the cottage emerging from the dark woods.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up on Juliana's face, wide-eyed with realization.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Surprised, Hesitant)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: That is it?

Juliana reflects that sitting with him makes her feel unafraid and safe.

logline: Seeking shelter from the cold rain, Juliana arrives at her new husband's modest woodland cottage and discovers an unexpected sense of peace beside the hearth.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Juliana's face, her voice catching with raw, suppressed emotion as she scrubs.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Vulnerable, Trembling)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: If I stop now, I will think about everything I lost.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium low shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man kneeling beside Juliana as she wipes the table.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Juliana picks up a straw broom and sweeps the stone floor in front of the stone hearth.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide shot of Juliana sweeping dust toward the large stone fireplace.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: The Mysterious Bearded Man carries a heavy wooden log across the room and places it onto the iron grate in the hearth.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Tracking shot following the Mysterious Bearded Man as he sets the firewood into the stone fireplace.

source_segments.text: He strikes flint and steel together over dry kindling, igniting bright sparks that catch into a flickering flame.

source_segments.text: Extreme close-up on hands striking flint, sparks showering onto the twigs and catching fire.

source_segments.text: Medium close-up of vibrant orange flames rapidly spreading across the dry logs, crackling warmly.

source_segments.label: SOUND FX
source_segments.text: Crisp crackling and snapping of dry wood catching fire in the hearth.

source_segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana standing by the table, broom resting against her hip, bathed in the amber firelight.

source_segments.text: The Mysterious Bearded Man stands up from the hearth, dusting his hands on his coat.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of the Mysterious Bearded Man rising before the blazing fireplace.

source_segments.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Relieved)
source_segments.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
source_segments.text: There.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Juliana looking at him with radiant gratitude and a gentle smile.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of the Mysterious Bearded Man gesturing faintly to the modest room.

source_segments.label: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN (Quiet, Modest)
source_segments.speaker: MYSTERIOUS BEARDED MAN
source_segments.text: It is not much.

source_segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana kneeling on the stone floor before the blazing hearth, wrapping her dark cloak around her shoulders.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Soft, Comforted)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: It is enough for tonight.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide shot framing the roaring hearth fire between them as the Mysterious Bearded Man crouches down beside her on the stone floor.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Juliana pulling her cloak tighter, her face glowing warmly in the firelight.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (V.O.) (Reflective, Vulnerable)

source_segments.text: I lost my home today.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (V.O.) (Reflective, Vulnerable)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: My family.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of the glowing embers and dancing flames inside the fireplace.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (V.O.) (Reflective, Vulnerable)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: Everything I thought my life would be.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on the Mysterious Bearded Man's scarred, work-worn hands resting quietly on his knees.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of Juliana looking down into the flames, a peaceful serenity washing over her features.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (V.O.) (Gentle, Surprised)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up overhead shot of Juliana asleep on her pillow as her eyelids flutter open, gasping and coughing violently from the choking smoke.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Juliana coughs, her eyes widening in immediate alarm as the smell of burning wood fills her lungs.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Juliana bolts upright in bed, tossing off the woolen quilt as she sees the orange glow under the door.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Screaming, Terrified)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: Alexander!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot as Juliana swings her bare legs out of bed onto the floor, trembling with panic.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Desperate, Shouting)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: Alexander!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Low-angle close shot of the bedroom door glowing intensely, fire licking the wooden floorboards as smoke pours inward.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Juliana sits huddled at the edge of the bed, pressing her bandaged hands against her mouth, coughing and sobbing in fear.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Muffled, Weeping)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: Alexander...

source_segments.label: SOUND FX
source_segments.text: A violent crash as the bedroom door is kicked open.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Framed in the doorway engulfed by blazing orange light, Alexander bursts in, his dark hair flying, looking like an imposing guardian amid the smoke.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Authoritative, Urgency)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: Juliana! Get up!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide tracking shot as Alexander rushes across the burning, smoke-choked room toward her bed.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Alexander reaches the bed, hoisting Juliana up by her arms into a standing embrace.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Breathless, Distressed)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: What happened?

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Grim, Urgent)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: Fire.

hook: A scarred man emerges from the fog and kneels, addressing Alexander as 'Your Grace', instantly revealing Alexander's hidden noble identity.
cliffhanger: Alexander declares 'Then Ashburg will remember who it belongs to,' leaving an intense promise of lethal vengeance.
standalone_clarity: A new viewer clearly understands that the male lead is an undercover nobleman whose family estate and mother have been seized, though specific past feuds require minor context.
narrative_context: Alexander meets in secret with a loyal informant in the forest to receive a grim update on his usurped estate and imprisoned mother.
promotional_strength: It highlights a high-stakes turning point where the protagonist shifts from a fugitive to a calculating lord plotting his reclamation.

evidence.observation: The informant bows and addresses Alexander as Your Grace.
Alexander reacts with cold fury upon learning his mother is a prisoner.
Alexander delivers a resolute vow that Ashburg will remember its true owner.

logline: Standing before the smoldering ash of their home, Juliana and Alexander receive shelter and food from grateful villagers before Alexander meets in secret with a loyal spy, learning that his usurping enemies have imprisoned his mother and claimed his ducal seat.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot tracking Alexander from behind as he stands waiting beside a moss-covered ancient tree trunk in the dense, fog-laden forest.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: A bald, scarred man dressed in a dark coat emerges from between the trees, immediately coming to a halt and bowing with clasped hands in formal deference.

source_segments.label: INFORMANT (Subservient, Urgent)
source_segments.speaker: INFORMANT
source_segments.text: Your Grace.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of Alexander turning toward his operative, his eyes dark with calculating authority.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Authoritative, Direct)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: Tell me what is happening in Ashburg.

source_segments.label: INFORMANT (Grave, Cautious)
source_segments.speaker: INFORMANT
source_segments.text: Lord Sterling's influence has grown since your disappearance. He has men in the county offices, the courts, even among the household staff.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Slow push-in on Alexander's rugged, scarred face, his jaw tightening with simmering rage as he listens.

source_segments.label: INFORMANT (O.S.)
source_segments.speaker: INFORMANT
source_segments.text: Rupert has become the face of Ashburg. He sits in your father's room, signs your estate papers, gives orders as though the title already belongs to him.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of the bald informant standing among the towering trees, reporting solemnly.

source_segments.label: INFORMANT (Earnest)
source_segments.speaker: INFORMANT
source_segments.text: And Lady Catherine, she behaves as though she is already the future duchess.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of the informant, his voice dropping into urgent, discreet concern.

source_segments.label: INFORMANT (Whispering, Alarmed)
source_segments.speaker: INFORMANT
source_segments.text: But they have separated her from the household. She is watched constantly. Every letter she sends is checked. Every visitor is questioned.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Extreme close-up of Alexander's right hand clenching into a powerful, trembling fist at his coat seam, veins bulging with restrained violence.

source_segments.label: INFORMANT (O.S.)
source_segments.speaker: INFORMANT
source_segments.text: There are almost no loyal servants left around her.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Low-angle shot past Alexander toward the informant.

source_segments.label: INFORMANT (Grave)
source_segments.speaker: INFORMANT
source_segments.text: The people who served your family for years have been dismissed, frightened away, or replaced.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Alexander lifts his gaze toward the cold forest canopy, his breathing heavy with profound anguish.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Cold, Pained Fury)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: My mother is a prisoner in her own house.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of the informant looking steadily at Alexander.

source_segments.label: INFORMANT (Quiet, Solemn)
source_segments.speaker: INFORMANT
source_segments.text: And everyone believes you are dead.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Extreme close-up of Alexander's scarred eye and grimly set mouth.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Lethal, Calculating)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: Then let them believe it a little longer.

source_segments.label: INFORMANT (Inquiring, Tense)
source_segments.speaker: INFORMANT
source_segments.text: And when we have the proof?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Dramatic low-angle push-in on Alexander's commanding silhouette, his combat scar etched sharply against the fog.

source_segments.label: ALEXANDER (Vow of Vengeance, Resolute)
source_segments.speaker: ALEXANDER
source_segments.text: Then Ashburg will remember who it belongs to.

hook: Catherine pours tea in an opulent drawing room and taunts Rupert about his climb to power, immediately establishing a high-society conspiracy.
cliffhanger: Rupert chillingly admits that he has ensured the Dowager Duchess will not survive the winter, revealing premeditated murder.
standalone_clarity: New viewers can easily understand that these two ambitious aristocrats are plotting to take over an estate and get rid of an elderly family member, though the exact familial background is missing.
narrative_context: Rupert and Catherine discuss their impending acquisition of the ducal title and the intentional decline of the Dowager Duchess.
promotional_strength: The cold ambition and casual discussion of murder by high-society villains creates a compelling hook for drama viewers.

evidence.observation: Establishes the opulent setting and Catherine and Rupert's interaction.
Rupert confirms he has ensured the Dowager Duchess's fatal decline.

logline: Inside the opulent Ashbury estate, the treacherous Rupert and Catherine plot to seize the ducal title as the Dowager Duchess slowly withers, while in an icy barn, Juliana defiantly prepares remedies to save the fever-stricken villagers.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium wide shot of the lavish drawing room. CATHERINE, dressed in an ornate lilac regency gown and white satin gloves, gracefully pours hot tea from an ornate silver teapot, while RUPERT stands elegantly by the tall window.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Smug, Prim)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: Two lumps of sugar, Rupert?

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Taunting, Silkily)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: Or has your sudden climb to power sweetened your taste already?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Catherine stirring her tea with a silver spoon, lifting her gaze with a haughty smirk.

source_segments.label: RUPERT (Flirtatious, Sly)
source_segments.speaker: RUPERT
source_segments.text: Only if it sweetens your disposition, Catherine.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot tracking Rupert as he steps forward from the hearth, adjusting his dark leather gloves with an air of absolute triumph.

source_segments.label: RUPERT (Boastful, Confident)
source_segments.speaker: RUPERT
source_segments.text: The estate is practically ours.

source_segments.label: RUPERT (Smug)
source_segments.speaker: RUPERT
source_segments.text: The succession papers are being finalized as we speak.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of Catherine raising the porcelain teacup to her lips, her expression turning sharp and dismissive.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Cold, Haughty)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: 'Practically' is a word for beggars. I do not marry a practical Duke.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Stern, Ambitious)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: I marry the Lord of Ashbury.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of Rupert striding toward the tea table, leaning forward with predatory conviction.

source_segments.label: RUPERT (Reassuring, Firm)
source_segments.speaker: RUPERT
source_segments.text: And so you shall.

source_segments.label: RUPERT (Dark, Conspiratorial)
source_segments.speaker: RUPERT
source_segments.text: Once my cousin Alexander's death is formally sealed by the Crown...

source_segments.label: RUPERT (Decisive)
source_segments.speaker: RUPERT
source_segments.text: ...the title is mine.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Catherine lowering her teacup, her icy blue eyes narrowing in calculated concern.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Wary, Inquiring)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: And what of the Dowager? The old woman still breathes.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Disdainful)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: Her shadow still hangs over this house.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Tight close-up of Rupert's face as a sinister grin spreads across his features.

source_segments.label: RUPERT (Quiet, Sinister)
source_segments.speaker: RUPERT
source_segments.text: Her health fails more each day. The physicians are baffled.

source_segments.label: RUPERT (Gloating)
source_segments.speaker: RUPERT
source_segments.text: They call it a wasting of the lungs.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up side profile of Catherine bringing the teacup to her lips, savoring his words with chilling detachment.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Mock-Sympathetic, Cruel)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: How tragic. The slow, quiet decline.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Scheming)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: How much longer can the frail thing survive?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium profile of Rupert looking out the window, hands clasped behind him.

source_segments.label: RUPERT (Cold, Callous)
source_segments.speaker: RUPERT
source_segments.text: Not through the winter. I've ensured her quiet comfort.

hook: A loud wooden slam and a frantic, weeping girl rushing in to declare that her little brother is dying.
cliffhanger: Juliana resolves to take her herbal ledger and rush to save the dying child despite having lost everything.
standalone_clarity: A new viewer can easily understand that a desperate child needs medical help and that institutional doctors have turned her away for lack of money.
narrative_context: Prudence begs Juliana to save her brother Toby after the apothecary and manor doctor reject them for having no silver.
promotional_strength: It highlights the contrast between aristocratic cruelty and the heroine's enduring compassion, immediately engaging the viewer with a high-stakes medical emergency.

evidence.observation: A loud wooden slam announces Prudence's frantic entrance.
Prudence reveals the apothecary shut the door in her face because they lack silver.
Juliana asserts her authority and prepares to save the boy.

logline: After defying her own despair to cure a fever-stricken village boy with her mother's herbal remedies, Lady Juliana learns that the Dowager Duchess is secretly withering away from a mysterious illness inside Ashbury Manor.

source_segments.label: SOUND FX
source_segments.text: A loud wooden slam as the heavy double barn doors violently fly open.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide shot framing the open doorway against the overcast daylight as Prudence, a young village girl in an apron, rushes inside, frantic and weeping.

source_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Desperate, Panicked)
source_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
source_segments.text: Lady Juliana! Please! You have to help me, Toby is dying!

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Lady Juliana hurries over, placing her bandaged hands reassuringly on Prudence's trembling shoulders.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of Lady Juliana looking into Prudence's tearful face with compassionate urgency.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Gentle, Urgent)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: Oh dear. Breathe. Tell me what has happened.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Prudence weeping, clutching her hands to her chest in agony.

source_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Sobbing, Breathless)
source_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
source_segments.text: My little brother Toby... his chest is burning! He cannot breathe!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Lady Juliana, her brow furrowing with concern.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Inquiring, Strained)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: Tell me what the apothecary said. Did he not give you medicine?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Prudence, her face twisted in bitter anguish as she gestures back toward the rain-soaked outdoors.

source_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Anguished, Resentful)
source_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
source_segments.text: He shut the door in my face because we have no silver!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide shot of Lady Juliana and Prudence facing each other inside the wooden barn, dust motes drifting in the pale light.

source_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Bitter, Tearful)
source_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
source_segments.text: The manor doctor laughed! He said village boys are not worth his time!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium profile shot of Lady Juliana looking down at her bandaged hands, holding Prudence's hand with somber heartache.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Sorrowful, Dejected)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: We have no clinic now.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Despondent)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: Our cottage is ashes. I have nothing left but this coltsfoot.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Prudence drops desperately to her knees onto the hay-strewn barn floor, clasping her hands in tearful supplication.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: High-angle looking down at Prudence kneeling before Lady Juliana, pleading upward.

source_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Pleading, Desperate)
source_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
source_segments.text: He is only seven! If you do not come, he will die! You are his only hope, Lady Juliana!

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Lady Juliana immediately reaches down and pulls Prudence firmly back to her feet, then turns to snatch her heavy leather-bound herbal ledger from the wooden workbench.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot framing the barn entrance as Lady Juliana lifts Prudence up, grabs her book, and leads the way out.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Resolute, Authoritative)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: Stand up. Sinking to your knees will not save him. Let me grab my ledger. We go now.

hook: Prudence expressing overwhelming gratitude to Juliana after her brother is saved.
cliffhanger: Juliana learns that the Dowager Duchess inside the manor is mysteriously and secretly dying, ending on a dramatic musical swell.
standalone_clarity: A viewer can understand that a life has been saved and that a new, high-stakes medical mystery involving a powerful figure has just been uncovered.
narrative_context: After Toby recovers, Prudence warns Juliana about the arrogant manor residents, leading to the revelation about the Dowager Duchess's failing health.
promotional_strength: It bridges the village storyline with the overarching aristocratic conspiracy, creating a compelling hook for the next episode.

evidence.observation: Prudence praises Juliana for saving her brother where grand doctors failed.
Prudence reveals the Dowager Duchess is fading away from a mysterious illness.
Juliana realizes the gravity of the situation as dramatic strings swell.

logline: After defying her own despair to cure a fever-stricken village boy with her mother's herbal remedies, Lady Juliana learns that the Dowager Duchess is secretly withering away from a mysterious illness inside Ashbury Manor.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of Prudence looking at Lady Juliana with awe and boundless gratitude, her hands clasped in front of her.

source_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Grateful, Choked with Emotion)
source_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
source_segments.text: You saved him. The grand doctors left him to choke, but you...

source_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Fervent, Devoted)
source_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
source_segments.text: I have no money, Lady Juliana, but I swear on my life, I will do anything to repay you.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Lady Juliana takes Prudence's trembling hands into hers, smiling with heartfelt warmth.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Lady Juliana comforting Prudence warmly.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Warm, Sincere)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: Your brother's breath is payment enough for me, Prudence.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Low-angle shot past sleeping Toby toward Prudence standing in the room, her expression darkening with anger.

source_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Indignant, Resentful)
source_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
source_segments.text: At the grand manor, they ignore us. They only care about their own luxury.

source_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Ominous)
source_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
source_segments.text: But their gold cannot buy them health.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Lady Juliana turns sharply, her eyes widening with sudden recognition.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Lady Juliana looking directly into Prudence's eyes with startled concern.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Startled, Curious)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: What do you mean? Is someone ill? The Dowager Duchess?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Low-angle cut to Toby sleeping peacefully as the fire crackles behind him.

source_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Solemn, O.S.)
source_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
source_segments.text: She is dying, Lady Juliana.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Prudence leaning in close to Lady Juliana, whispering with grave intensity.

source_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Conspiratorial, Grim)
source_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
source_segments.text: A strange, mysterious illness is eating her away.

source_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Dark, Chilling)
source_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
source_segments.text: Inside that massive house with all their wealth, she is fading to nothing, and no one can stop it.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Brief cut back to Toby sleeping peacefully on his straw pillow by the warm fireplace.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Lady Juliana sits motionless at the rustic wooden table, her bandaged hands holding open her late mother's leather-bound herbal ledger. Her eyes reflect deep apprehension as the dire truth settles over her.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Slow push-in on Lady Juliana staring down at the ancient pages, her expression filled with profound realization and growing resolve as dramatic strings swell to a gripping cliffhanger.

hook: Lady Juliana arrives at the gothic gates of Ashbury Manor in disguise, immediately establishing high stakes as Prudence warns her that discovery means everything is over.
cliffhanger: Juliana steps through the heavy service door as the latch clicks shut, committing fully to her dangerous infiltration.
standalone_clarity: A new viewer can easily understand that a noblewoman is going undercover into a dangerous estate under a strict deadline, with missing context regarding her exact past relationship to the estate easily inferred from the high tension.
narrative_context: Lady Juliana adopts a maid's disguise to sneak into Ashbury Manor and save the dying Dowager Duchess.
promotional_strength: Combines a classic undercover trope with strong tension, high stakes, and a clear sense of impending danger.

evidence.observation: Juliana walks nervously along the stone pavement in a maid's dress.
Prudence warns Juliana to keep her head down to avoid recognition.
Prudence opens the service door and both women step inside into the dark corridor.

logline: Disguised as a common scullery maid, Lady Juliana infiltrates Ashbury Manor alongside Prudence and slips into the forbidden West Wing, where she discovers the dying Dowager Duchess suffering from an unnatural, poisoned affliction.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide shot framing the gothic stone archway of Ashbury Manor as other maidservants carrying laundry baskets pass through the damp courtyard.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Lady Juliana walks nervously along the stone pavement dressed in a modest dark maid's dress and a plain white apron, looking around cautiously.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of Lady Juliana adjusting her high buttoned collar, anxious yet determined, against the backdrop of the gloomy coast.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Prudence rushes up behind Lady Juliana, pulling her into the shelter of the stone archway.

source_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Urgent, Whispering)
source_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
source_segments.text: Keep your head down. If anyone recognizes you, everything is over.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Lady Juliana leaning back against the rough stone wall, whispering back firmly.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Resolute, Quiet)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: No one will recognize me dressed like this.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of Prudence glancing nervously toward the courtyard before fixing her gaze on Juliana.

source_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Nervous, Warning)
source_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
source_segments.text: This is Ashburton Manor. The housekeeper watches everyone. Lady Catherine watches everyone, and Lord Rupert...

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Lady Juliana cutting in with fierce, unyielding conviction.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Determined)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: The Duchess is dying.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Low-angle shot looking up at Lady Juliana and Prudence standing beneath the looming stone facade of the manor.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Defiant, Firm)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: I saved Toby. I can save her.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Prudence, her eyes wide with dread.

source_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Fretful)
source_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
source_segments.text: And if they discover who you are?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up on Lady Juliana holding her gaze steadily.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Steely, Selfless)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: Then I will face that when she is breathing again.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium two-shot outside the heavy wooden servant entrance door.

source_segments.label: PRUDENCE (Solemn)
source_segments.speaker: PRUDENCE
source_segments.text: Then forget you were ever a lady.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Lady Juliana swallowing her pride and accepting her perilous disguise.

source_segments.label: LADY JULIANA (Quietly Resolute)
source_segments.speaker: LADY JULIANA
source_segments.text: Today, I am only a maid.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Prudence opens the heavy wooden service door, and both women step inside into the dark servants' corridor as the door shuts firmly behind them.

source_segments.label: SOUND FX
source_segments.text: Heavy wooden latch clicks shut with a thud.

hook: Lady Juliana quietly picks a locked door in a grand, shadowy manor and enters a secluded bedroom where a frail figure lies breathing shallowly.
cliffhanger: The Dowager Duchess stares up with terrified, wide eyes, choking for air as dramatic music hits an abrupt cliffhanger.
standalone_clarity: A new viewer can grasp that a secret medical rescue is underway in a forbidden room, with the horrific discovery of foul play driving the narrative forward.
narrative_context: Juliana enters the forbidden West Wing of Ashbury Manor, examines the ailing Dowager Duchess, and uncovers evidence of a malicious poisoning.
promotional_strength: Delivers intense mystery, medical intrigue, and a suspenseful cliffhanger that hooks viewers into finding out who is behind the poisoning.

evidence.observation: Juliana tracks into a shadowy bedchamber where the frail Duchess lies motionless.

source_segments.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
source_segments.text: You hear that?!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Lady Catherine twisting Juliana's words with malicious glee.

source_segments.label: LADY CATHERINE (Venomous, Accusing)
source_segments.speaker: LADY CATHERINE
source_segments.text: She admits she has been giving the Duchess poison in secret!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Juliana recoiling in shock at the blatant lie.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Desperate, Outraged)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: That is not what I said!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of the Blond Nobleman raising his black-gloved hand, silencing the room.

source_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Authoritative, Icy)
source_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: Enough.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium two-shot as the Blond Nobleman steps into Juliana's personal space and plucks the glass dropper vial from her hand.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: The Blond Nobleman takes the medicine vial from Juliana's grasp, inspecting it under the candlelight.

source_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Cold, Calculating)
source_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: An unknown servant enters a restricted chamber.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Tight close-up of the Blond Nobleman holding the vial beside his temple, his blue eyes cold and triumphant.

source_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Condemning, Vindictive)
source_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: She secretly administers an unidentified substance to a helpless woman.

source_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (To Guard, Stern)
source_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: Take her.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide shot as the armed guard storms forward, seizing Juliana roughly by both arms.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: The guard twists Juliana around and drags her forcibly toward the doorway as she struggles against his grip.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana being pulled backward, casting a frantic glance back toward the bedridden Duchess.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana's wide, terrified eyes as she realizes the deadly trap closing around her, cutting abruptly to black.

hook: The bedridden Dowager Duchess suddenly stirs and shouts commands to stop the guards, directly confronting Rupert and Catherine.
cliffhanger: Rupert dismisses the Duchess's accusations as madness and orders Juliana to be dragged away.
standalone_clarity: A new viewer can easily grasp that an older matriarch is trying to save an accused woman and exposing the villains, though the exact backstory of the poison requires minimal context.
narrative_context: The Duchess awakens just as Juliana is being framed and condemned, turning the tables by pointing the finger directly at Rupert and Catherine.
promotional_strength: High dramatic tension as the victim exposes her abusers in front of everyone, only for the villains to gaslight her and maintain control.

evidence.observation: The Dowager Duchess stirs and speaks up.
The Duchess accuses Rupert and Catherine of poisoning her.
Rupert orders Juliana to be taken away.

logline: Rupert and Catherine frame Juliana for poisoning the Duchess despite the bedridden matriarch's protests, uncovering Juliana's true noble identity and her mother's herbarium before ordering her to the castle dungeons.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of the Dowager Duchess stirring against her pillows, lifting her trembling head with visible effort.

source_segments.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Weak, Straining)
source_segments.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
source_segments.text: Rupert...

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of Rupert pausing mid-stride as he hears his mother's voice, slowly turning his head toward the bed.

source_segments.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (O.S.) (Commanding)
source_segments.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
source_segments.text: Stop this!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide shot of the bedchamber framed through the bed curtains as the Duchess props herself up on one elbow and points an accusing finger.

source_segments.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Desperate, Firm)
source_segments.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
source_segments.text: She is innocent.

source_segments.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Adamant)
source_segments.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
source_segments.text: She saved me!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Juliana, tears of relief welling in her eyes.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Breathless, Relieved)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: Your Grace...

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of the Duchess clutching at her nightgown, her face twisted in mounting fury and horror.

source_segments.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Trembling, Shouting)
source_segments.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
source_segments.text: I know what happened to me!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium low-angle shot past the Duchess pointing directly at Rupert, who stands rigid and expressionless.

source_segments.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Fierce, Condemning)
source_segments.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
source_segments.text: I was poisoned!

source_segments.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Accusing)
source_segments.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
source_segments.text: And you... you knew!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of the Duchess lunging forward from the pillows, gasping for breath as she points toward Catherine.

source_segments.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Choking, Weakening)
source_segments.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
source_segments.text: Catherine knew!

source_segments.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Gasping)
source_segments.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
source_segments.text: They have been—

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: The Duchess collapses back onto the pillows, coughing violently and clutching her chest.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide shot as Juliana lunges across the room toward the bed, but the armed guard seizes her from behind and drags her back.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Panicked, Screaming)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: Let me help her!

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Desperate)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: She's still weak, you cannot leave her like this!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of Rupert smoothing down his black leather gloves, a chilling smile forming on his lips.

source_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Smooth, Feigning Concern)
source_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: You see?

source_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Sinister)
source_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: The poison has clearly damaged her mind.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Over-the-shoulder shot of Rupert leaning menacingly over the gasping Duchess in bed.

source_segments.label: DOWAGER DUCHESS (Hoarse, Straining)
source_segments.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
source_segments.text: I am not delusional!

source_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Condescending, Whispering)
source_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: Of course you are not.

source_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Dismissive)
source_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: You are merely confused.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium profile tracking shot of Catherine walking deliberately toward Juliana, speaking with airy cynicism.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Amused, Mocking)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: How convenient that the only person who can prove the poison exists...

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Smug)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: ...is the maid who claims to have discovered it.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Low-angle medium shot of Rupert turning sharply toward the guard, his eyes icy and authoritative.

source_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Commanding, Resolute)
source_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: Take her away before she poisons the rest of this house.

hook: Catherine picks up Juliana's fallen book and discovers her true identity as Lady Juliana Ashcroft.
cliffhanger: Juliana is wrenched backward into the dark hallway as Catherine sentences her to face the magistrate.
standalone_clarity: A viewer can understand that a hidden noble identity has been uncovered, leading to severe retaliation and imprisonment.
narrative_context: Catherine realizes who Juliana really is and uses her past against her before ordering her to the wet cells.
promotional_strength: Features a powerful identity reveal and intense confrontation that highlights the antagonist's cruelty and the protagonist's desperate plight.

evidence.observation: Catherine reads 'Juliana Ashcroft'.
Catherine reveals Juliana's true noble name.
Juliana is dragged away into the dark hallway.

logline: Rupert and Catherine frame Juliana for poisoning the Duchess despite the bedridden matriarch's protests, uncovering Juliana's true noble identity and her mother's herbarium before ordering her to the castle dungeons.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of Catherine walking toward the fallen leather-bound book and kneeling gracefully to pick it up.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Catherine lifts the heavy herbarium, dusting off the cover before opening its aged parchment pages.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Tight close-up of Catherine reading the elegant cursive script inside the front cover.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Intrigued, Murmuring)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: Juliana...

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Extreme close-up on the handwritten inscription: 'Juliana Ashcroft'.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana freezing in the doorway as she sees Catherine opening her mother's book.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: Juliana gasps in horror, realizing her secret identity has been laid bare.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Catherine raising her gaze slowly from the book, a wicked, triumphant grin spreading across her face.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Triumphant, Venomous)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: Lady Juliana Ashcroft.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium two-shot as Catherine steps deliberately up to Juliana, circling her like a predator savoring its prey.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Mocking, Reveling)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: I knew I had seen those eyes before.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Cruel)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: The disgraced daughter...

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Scornful)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: ...the girl thrown out of her own family home.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up two-shot of Catherine leaning inches from Juliana's face, whispering her humiliating past.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Taunting)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: The bride who married a penniless war veteran...

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Vicious)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: ...because no respectable man would have her.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Tight close-up of Juliana's eyes blazing with explosive fury and defensive loyalty.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Screaming, Wildly Defiant)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: Do not speak about my husband!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium two-shot as Catherine throws her head back in derisive laughter, brandishing the herbarium book.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Laughing, Scornful)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: And look at you now. Scrubbing fireplaces in my house.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Mocking)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: What a magnificent fall, Lady Juliana.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of Rupert gesturing toward the exit with an outstretched arm.

source_segments.label: BLOND NOBLEMAN (Harsh, Authoritative)
source_segments.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: Drag her to the wet cells beneath the south tower.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Catherine fanning open the illustrated botanical pages of the herbarium with gloved fingers.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Smug)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: And this?

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Gleeful)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: This book of weeds will hang her before the magistrate.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana thrashing frantically against the guard's grip, her arm reaching out toward the book.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Screaming, Desperate)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: That book is my mother's life's work!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of Catherine smiling coldly, clutching the closed book against her bodice.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Icy, Threatening)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: Then perhaps you can explain every page to the magistrate...

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Fateful, Vengeful)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: ...before he sends you to the gallows.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Extreme close-up of Juliana's wide, trembling eyes as the guard wrenches her backward into the dark hallway, cutting sharply to black.

hook: Catherine mocks Juliana's mother's botanical book as 'weeds' and coldly threatens to have her tried for witchcraft.
cliffhanger: Catherine threatens to burn the book and hang Juliana so that no one will remember what was written inside.
standalone_clarity: A new viewer can easily grasp the intense conflict between an arrogant antagonist destroying a precious keepsake and a desperate prisoner fighting back. Context needed is simply that Juliana is wrongfully imprisoned.
narrative_context: Catherine confronts the imprisoned Juliana in the dungeon corridors, taunting her with her mother's herbarium and outlining her malicious plan for execution.
promotional_strength: Features high-stakes interpersonal conflict, strong villainous coldness, and passionate defiance from the protagonist.

evidence.observation: Catherine mocks the botanical book.
Catherine threatens Juliana with witchcraft charges.
Catherine states she can burn the book.

logline: Thrown into the castle's subterranean wet cells as Catherine threatens to burn her mother's herbarium and frame her for witchcraft, Juliana breaks down in isolation before swearing that they will never take Alexander from her.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up pushing in on Catherine as she presents the worn botanical book with both gloved hands.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Mocking, Condescending)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: Your mother's little book of weeds?

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Cruel, Smug)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: You still call this a legacy?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Juliana held firmly between the guards, glaring back with fierce defiance.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Defiant, Furious)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: It is medicine!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of Catherine smiling condescendingly.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Smooth, Patronizing)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: Of course.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Overhead close-up of Catherine's gloved fingers flipping through the herbarium's delicate, hand-drawn floral remedies and annotations.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (O.S.) (Disdainful, Calculating)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: Roots. Leaves. Powders. Strange mixtures written in a dead woman's hand.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of Catherine tucking the book under her arm, her eyes glinting with malicious intent.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Icy, Threatening)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: The magistrate will call it witchcraft.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Juliana lunging against the guard's grip, her teeth bared in indignation.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Furious, Shouted)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: You know that is a lie!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of Catherine lifting her chin arrogantly against the stone backdrop.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Calm, Sinister)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: I know exactly what I need him to believe.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of Juliana thrashing frantically against the two guards.

source_segments.label: JULIANA (Screaming, Desperate)
source_segments.speaker: JULIANA
source_segments.text: You cannot just destroy it!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Tight close-up of Catherine's eyes narrowing into an icy, venomous gaze.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Whispered, Malicious)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: I can burn it.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Juliana's stricken expression, her eyes widening in horror.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (O.S.) (Chilling, Relentless)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: And when they find your corpse at the end of the rope...

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Side close-up of Catherine leaning slightly forward, her voice low and merciless.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Cruel, Resolute)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: ...no one will remember what was written inside.

hook: An austere elder nobleman confronts Rupert in a grand hallway, sharply telling him 'You have a rat in your cellar,' immediately establishing tension and a hidden threat.
cliffhanger: The elder nobleman announces they will stop hiding the prisoner and give people a reason to condemn her.
standalone_clarity: A new viewer can easily understand that a powerful conspiracy is panicking over a hidden prisoner in their cellar, though specific backstories on Juliana are absent.
narrative_context: The elder nobleman confronts Rupert about rumors spreading regarding the imprisoned Juliana and insists on a more ruthless solution.
promotional_strength: The sharp conflict and intimidation establish immediate high-stakes villainy and intrigue.

evidence.observation: Establishes the arrival of the stern elder nobleman.
The nobleman warns Rupert about whispers regarding the prisoner.
The nobleman pins Rupert against the wall with his cane.

logline: When rumors of the poisoned Duchess begin spreading among the servants, Rupert and Catherine conspire with an elder nobleman to fabricate a witchcraft charge against Juliana, sealing her fate for the gallows.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Low-angle tracking shot following polished black dress shoes and the tip of a gold-handled cane striding deliberately along a sunlit marble hallway, tilting up gradually to reveal an austere, grey-haired elder nobleman.

source_segments.label: SOUND FX
source_segments.text: Rhythmic, heavy footsteps and the sharp metallic click of a cane striking the polished stone floor.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: The Elder Nobleman walks with stern, unhurried authority, dressed in an immaculate black tailcoat and dark vest with a gold pocket watch chain.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of Rupert standing nervously beside ornate double doors, wearing black gloves and an embroidered dark coat, glancing up with anxiety.

source_segments.label: SOUND FX
source_segments.text: A firm tap of the wooden walking stick halting against the floor.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Two-shot profile of the Elder Nobleman facing Rupert in the vaulted corridor.

source_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Cold, Accusatory)
source_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: You have a rat in your cellar, Rupert. And the servants are beginning to smell it.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Rupert defensive and agitated.

source_segments.label: RUPERT (Defensive, Anxious)
source_segments.speaker: RUPERT
source_segments.text: The Ashcroft girl is locked tight. Nobody knows she is down there.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium close-up of the Elder Nobleman fixing Rupert with a piercing, contemptuous glare.

source_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Stern, Disapproving)
source_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: The kitchen maids are whispering. They see the soup bowls returned unwiped. They see your guards outside the lower grates.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot of Rupert looking down, nervously pulling at his black leather gloves as dread creeps over his face.

source_segments.label: RUPERT (Muttered, Paranoid)
source_segments.speaker: RUPERT
source_segments.text: She knows the Duchess was poisoned.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Tight close-up on the Elder Nobleman's unyielding eyes narrowing in cold calculation.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Tight close-up of Rupert swallows hard, breathless with dread.

source_segments.label: RUPERT (Fearful)
source_segments.speaker: RUPERT
source_segments.text: If she speaks...

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium two-shot as the Elder Nobleman lunges forward aggressively, stepping into Rupert's personal space.

source_segments.label: ACTION
source_segments.text: The Elder Nobleman thrusts the gold knob of his walking stick directly against Rupert's chest, pinning him against the wall.

source_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Fierce, Venomous)
source_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: Then make certain she isn't! A peasant weed, Rupert! You do not store weeds in your cellar, you burn them!

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Low-angle close-up of Rupert gasping softly, intimidated by the cane pressed firmly beneath his cravat.

source_segments.label: RUPERT (Faltering, Submissive)
source_segments.speaker: RUPERT
source_segments.text: What are you suggesting?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Medium shot as the Elder Nobleman withdraws his cane and turns sharply toward the library doors.

source_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Calculated, Ominous)
source_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: We stop hiding the prisoner.

hook: The heavy mahogany doors swing open and the conspirators gather around a fireplace to plan how to legally destroy their captive.
cliffhanger: When Catherine asks what to do if the prisoner claims to be a healer, the nobleman chillingly replies, 'Then call it witchcraft.'
standalone_clarity: Clearly showcases villains plotting a judicial frame-up, making the stakes obvious to any viewer.
narrative_context: The conspirators formulate their evil plan to escalate a prisoner's case into a capital witchcraft charge.
promotional_strength: Delivers a chilling villainous plotting sequence that highlights the ruthlessness of the antagonists.

evidence.observation: The nobleman outlines the strategy to use the law to destroy the prisoner.
The nobleman chillingly suggests calling the healer's defense witchcraft.

logline: When rumors of the poisoned Duchess begin spreading among the servants, Rupert and Catherine conspire with an elder nobleman to fabricate a witchcraft charge against Juliana, sealing her fate for the gallows.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Tracking shot from behind the Elder Nobleman as he pushes open the heavy double doors into the dark wood-paneled library.

source_segments.label: SOUND FX
source_segments.text: The heavy creak of massive mahogany doors gliding open on brass hinges.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Front medium shot of the Elder Nobleman pausing inside the library doorway, Rupert following behind him.

source_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Deadpan, Sinister)
source_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: We give them a reason to condemn her.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Wide shot of Catherine standing regally before the roaring stone hearth, dressed in an ornate burgundy and gold brocade gown, slowly unfurling a red lace fan.

source_segments.label: CATHERINE (Inquiring, Sharp)
source_segments.speaker: CATHERINE
source_segments.text: You have a solution?

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Side profile close-up of the Elder Nobleman speaking with icy confidence.

source_segments.label: ELDER NOBLEMAN (Ruthless)
source_segments.speaker: ELDER NOBLEMAN
source_segments.text: We use the law to destroy her.

source_segments.label: CAMERA
source_segments.text: Close-up of Rupert looking bewildered.

source_segments.label: RUPERT (Confused)
source_segments.speaker: RUPERT
source_segments.text: The law?
